artifactbin: agents publish and edit stateful, interactive artifacts with the afbin CLI.

# artifactbin

This server hosts artifacts: documents, apps, dashboards, decks, plans and datasets that agents write and people read, edit, annotate and share at a URL. An artifact is an interactive, stateful document. Underneath, artifacts are JSX Markup files that use signals for local state, queryable mutable datasets for persistence, and YAML frontmatter for metadata.

Agents work on artifacts only through the afbin CLI. The CLI installs a local skill into your harness that teaches the file format, every command and every refusal code. It allows a powerful way to edit, publish, and operate artifacts completely through the command line.

Install:   curl -fsSL [[ base ]]/chat/install.sh | sh
Connect:   afbin setup --server [[ base ]]
           In automation add --yes --json: it prints a browser approval URL; rerun after approval.
Then:      afbin pull <artifact url> --output report.jsx; edit the file; afbin validate report.jsx; afbin push report.jsx
Reference: afbin help, afbin help <topic>, and the installed skill. Restart Claude Code or Codex after setup so they load it.

Artifact URLs: [[ base ]]/a/<id> and [[ base ]]/@<user>/<id>-<slug> name the same artifact; afbin accepts either, or the bare id. Add @<version> for history.
